content.text: No exclusivity obligation on Customer exists anywhere; § 12.3 affirmatively confirms this, and § 2.1 disclaims any purchase commitment.

input.quote: Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Customer, so the preferred position is met. § 12.3 expressly preserves Customer's freedom to develop, acquire, license, sell or use any product or service and to engage any supplier, and records Vendor's acknowledgement that Customer has made no exclusivity commitment; § 2.1 reinforces this by confirming that no minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies and that a decision not to place further Order Forms is not a breach. The only exclusivity-style restriction runs the other way (§ 12.4 restrains Vendor from marketing a competing service), which benefits Customer and is not flagged. Other uses of "exclusive" in the document (non-exclusive licence, exclusive remedy, exclusive jurisdiction) are unrelated to exclusive dealing.
